study: Watanabe et al. — Quer-Gold onion cooking
food_matrix: Allium cepa edible bulb; Hokkaido-grown Quer-Gold and Kitamomiji 2000
analyte_and_form: Total quercetin aglycone-equivalent after hydrolysis of glycosides
raw_cooked_conditions: Raw and sautéed; 160°C; 6% oil; 20% and 50% mass-loss endpoints
reported_units: mg/100 g initial fresh onion weight
basis_and_yield: Fresh-weight denominator normalized to uncooked onion; added oil/water loss corrected; yield endpoints measured
method_and_replication: Validated HPLC aglycone method; three cooking preparations; two analytical replicates averaged; n=3 mean±SD
exact_blocker: B011 is direct free quercetin; this study hydrolyzes conjugates and reports total aglycone-equivalent; cultivar also differs and no matching Stage C cooked estimate is present.

study: Cattivelli et al. — onion cooking and bioaccessibility
food_matrix: Allium cepa bulbs; yellow- and red-skinned retail onions
analyte_and_form: Free quercetin listed, but flavonols quantified as quercetin-3-O-glucoside equivalents
raw_cooked_conditions: Raw; baked 180°C/30 min; boiled 100°C/30 min 1:5 onion:water; fried 140°C/8 min; grilled 110°C/15 min
reported_units: Tables 2-3: mg/100 g raw or cooked onion; Fig. 1: mg/100 g initial fresh weight
basis_and_yield: Separate cooked-weight and initial-fresh-weight denominators; initial/final weights and cooking loss in Table 1
method_and_replication: LC-ESI-ion-trap MS; 3 cooking trials; triplicate analyses, mean±SD
exact_blocker: Flavonol-equivalent calibration is not the authentic-quercetin calibration used for B011; variety and cooked endpoint also do not match a Stage C prediction.

study: Nishimuro et al. — seasonal quercetin food sources
food_matrix: Allium cepa edible onion from Sobetsu-area markets; seasonal planting/origin differs
analyte_and_form: Hydrolysis-released quercetin aglycone (total conjugated plus free quercetin)
raw_cooked_conditions: Onion samples stir-fried before freeze-drying; summer/winter sample relationship in Table 1 is not an explicit paired raw/cooked table
basis_and_yield: Fresh-weight edible portion; no cooked yield/mass balance located
method_and_replication: HCl hydrolysis then HPLC-PDA at 370 nm; 1-3 purchases, each sample in analytical triplicate
exact_blocker: Total hydrolyzed quercetin differs from direct free quercetin; raw/cooked pairing and cooked yield are insufficiently resolved.

study: Németh et al. — boiling yellow onion quercetin glucosides
food_matrix: Yellow onion fleshy scales, raw onion, boiled solids and soup
raw_cooked_conditions: 30 min reflux boiling at onion:water 1:5, 1:10, 1:20 w/w
reported_units: Not verified as compatible fresh-weight unit in accessible locator
basis_and_yield: Lyophilized onion and soup fractions; onion:water ratio defined, cooked solids yield not verified
method_and_replication: Acidified methanol extraction, HPLC-UV; replication not stated in inspected text
exact_blocker: Glycosides are different target analytes; fresh-weight units and replication not verified; boiling conditions do not match a Stage C prediction.

study: Harris et al. — onion quercetin glycosides after thermal processing
food_matrix: Allium cepa inner flesh, local Dublin retail onions
analyte_and_form: Quercetin-3,4'-diglucoside and quercetin-4'-monoglucoside; free quercetin not detected
raw_cooked_conditions: Fry, bake and steam for 5, 10 and 15 min
reported_units: Table units not verified from accessible full text
basis_and_yield: Freeze-dried fresh/control and cooked extracts; mass/yield basis not verified
method_and_replication: Chromatographic glycoside analysis; abstract n=3, biological/analytical meaning unresolved
accessibility: PubMed/publisher preview; numeric full table not accessible
exact_blocker: Wrong compound forms; published Table 1 units/basis and yield could not be independently verified.

raw_cooked_conditions: Raw control; sautéing, baking and boiling

accessibility: Publisher preview and AGRIS metadata; full quantitative article table not accessible
